title: refine and superRefine: Use refine for a single boolean invariant and superRefine for multiple custom, path-aware issues. In Zod 4, superRefine remains supported but is deprecated in favor of check.
description: Zod 4 schema design with actual runtime parsing, negative test cases, a deliberately broken learner implementation, instructor solution and security boundaries.
